    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Spring AI Alibaba 项目源码学习（八）-Flow Agent 分析</span>

            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="flow-agent-分析">Flow Agent 分析</h1>
<p>请关注微信公众号：<a href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/1POBRXDahByqmKNZ5Y5MZA" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">阿呆-bot</a></p>
<h2 id="概述">概述</h2>
<p>本文档分析 Spring AI Alibaba Agent Framework 中的 Flow Agent 系列，包括 <code>FlowAgent</code> 基类、<code>SequentialAgent</code>、<code>ParallelAgent</code>、<code>LoopAgent</code> 和 <code>LlmRoutingAgent</code> 的具体实现，重点分析其关键方法、功能职责和节点能力。</p>
<h2 id="入口类说明">入口类说明</h2>
<h3 id="flowagent---flow-agent-基类">FlowAgent - Flow Agent 基类</h3>
<p><code>FlowAgent</code> 是所有 Flow Agent 的抽象基类，继承自 <code>Agent</code>，提供了多 Agent 编排的基础能力。</p>
<p><strong>核心职责</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>管理子 Agent 列表</li>
<li>提供 Graph 构建的抽象方法</li>
<li>委托给 <code>FlowGraphBuilder</code> 构建图</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-34:95:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/flow/agent/FlowAgent.java">public abstract class FlowAgent extends Agent {

	protected List&lt;String&gt; interruptBefore;

	protected List&lt;Agent&gt; subAgents;

	protected FlowAgent(String name, String description, CompileConfig compileConfig, List&lt;Agent&gt; subAgents)
			throws GraphStateException {
		super(name, description);
		this.compileConfig = compileConfig;
		this.subAgents = subAgents;
	}

	@Override
	protected StateGraph initGraph() throws GraphStateException {
		// Use FlowGraphBuilder to construct the graph
		FlowGraphBuilder.FlowGraphConfig config = FlowGraphBuilder.FlowGraphConfig.builder()
			.name(this.name())
			.rootAgent(this)
			.subAgents(this.subAgents());

		// Delegate to specific graph builder based on agent type
		return buildSpecificGraph(config);
	}

	@Override
	public ScheduledAgentTask schedule(ScheduleConfig scheduleConfig) throws GraphStateException {
		CompiledGraph compiledGraph = getAndCompileGraph();
		return compiledGraph.schedule(scheduleConfig);
	}

	public StateGraph asStateGraph(){
		return getGraph();
	}

	/**
	 * Abstract method for subclasses to specify their graph building strategy. This
	 * method should be implemented by concrete FlowAgent subclasses to define how their
	 * specific graph structure should be built.
	 * @param config the graph configuration
	 * @return the constructed StateGraph
	 * @throws GraphStateException if graph construction fails
	 */
	protected abstract StateGraph buildSpecificGraph(FlowGraphBuilder.FlowGraphConfig config)
			throws GraphStateException;

	public CompileConfig compileConfig() {
		return compileConfig;
	}

	public List&lt;Agent&gt; subAgents() {
		return this.subAgents;
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with messages and input for String message
	 */
	private Map&lt;String, Object&gt; createInputMap(String message) {
		return Map.of("messages", convertToMessages(message), "input", message);
	}

}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>关键方法</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>buildSpecificGraph()</code>：抽象方法，子类实现具体的图构建策略</li>
<li><code>subAgents()</code>：获取子 Agent 列表</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="sequentialagent---顺序执行-agent">SequentialAgent - 顺序执行 Agent</h3>
<p><code>SequentialAgent</code> 按顺序执行多个子 Agent，前一个 Agent 的输出作为下一个 Agent 的输入。</p>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-24:64:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/flow/agent/SequentialAgent.java">public class SequentialAgent extends FlowAgent {

	protected SequentialAgent(SequentialAgentBuilder builder) throws GraphStateException {
		super(builder.name, builder.description, builder.compileConfig, builder.subAgents);
	}

	public static SequentialAgentBuilder builder() {
		return new SequentialAgentBuilder();
	}

	@Override
	protected StateGraph buildSpecificGraph(FlowGraphBuilder.FlowGraphConfig config) throws GraphStateException {
		return FlowGraphBuilder.buildGraph(FlowAgentEnum.SEQUENTIAL.getType(), config);
	}

	/**
	 * Builder for creating SequentialAgent instances. Extends the common FlowAgentBuilder
	 * to provide type-safe building.
	 */
	public static class SequentialAgentBuilder extends FlowAgentBuilder&lt;SequentialAgent, SequentialAgentBuilder&gt; {

		@Override
		protected SequentialAgentBuilder self() {
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		protected void validate() {
			super.validate();
			// Add any SequentialAgent-specific validation here if needed
		}

		@Override
		public SequentialAgent build() throws GraphStateException {
			validate();
			return new SequentialAgent(this);
		}

	}

}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>执行模式</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>Agent1 → Agent2 → Agent3 → ... → END</li>
<li>每个 Agent 的输出作为下一个 Agent 的输入</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="parallelagent---并行执行-agent">ParallelAgent - 并行执行 Agent</h3>
<p><code>ParallelAgent</code> 并行执行多个子 Agent，然后合并结果。</p>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-54:100:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/flow/agent/ParallelAgent.java">public class ParallelAgent extends FlowAgent {

	private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ParallelAgent.class);

	private final MergeStrategy mergeStrategy;

	private String mergeOutputKey;

	private final Integer maxConcurrency;

	protected ParallelAgent(ParallelAgentBuilder builder) throws GraphStateException {
		super(builder.name, builder.description, builder.compileConfig, builder.subAgents);
		this.mergeStrategy = builder.mergeStrategy != null ? builder.mergeStrategy : new DefaultMergeStrategy();
		this.maxConcurrency = builder.maxConcurrency;
		this.mergeOutputKey = builder.mergeOutputKey;
	}

	public static ParallelAgentBuilder builder() {
		return new ParallelAgentBuilder();
	}

	@Override
	protected StateGraph buildSpecificGraph(FlowGraphBuilder.FlowGraphConfig config) throws GraphStateException {
		// Add parallel-specific properties to config
		config.customProperty("mergeStrategy", this.mergeStrategy);
		config.customProperty("maxConcurrency", this.maxConcurrency);

		return FlowGraphBuilder.buildGraph(FlowAgentEnum.PARALLEL.getType(), config);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets the merge strategy used by this ParallelAgent.
	 * @return the merge strategy
	 */
	public MergeStrategy mergeStrategy() {
		return mergeStrategy;
	}

	public String mergeOutputKey() {
		return mergeOutputKey;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets the maximum concurrency limit for this ParallelAgent.
	 * @return the max concurrency, or null if unlimited
	 */
	public Integer maxConcurrency() {
</code></pre>
<p><strong>执行模式</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>所有子 Agent 同时执行（Fan-Out）</li>
<li>执行完成后合并结果（Gather）</li>
<li>支持最大并发数限制</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="loopagent---循环执行-agent">LoopAgent - 循环执行 Agent</h3>
<p><code>LoopAgent</code> 循环执行一个子 Agent，支持多种循环策略。</p>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-58:100:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/flow/agent/LoopAgent.java">public class LoopAgent extends FlowAgent {

    private final LoopStrategy loopStrategy;

    public static final String LOOP_STRATEGY = "loopStrategy";

    private LoopAgent(LoopAgentBuilder builder) throws GraphStateException {
        super(builder.name, builder.description, builder.compileConfig, builder.subAgents);
        this.loopStrategy = builder.loopStrategy;
    }

    @Override
    protected StateGraph buildSpecificGraph(FlowGraphBuilder.FlowGraphConfig config) throws GraphStateException {
        config.customProperty(LOOP_STRATEGY, loopStrategy);
        return FlowGraphBuilder.buildGraph(FlowAgentEnum.LOOP.getType(), config);
    }

    public static LoopAgentBuilder builder() {
        return new LoopAgentBuilder();
    }

    public static class LoopAgentBuilder extends FlowAgentBuilder&lt;LoopAgent, LoopAgentBuilder&gt; {

        private LoopStrategy loopStrategy = null;

        @Override
        protected LoopAgentBuilder self() {
            return this;
        }

        public LoopAgentBuilder subAgent(Agent subAgent) {
            this.subAgents = List.of(subAgent);
            return self();
        }

        @Override
        public LoopAgentBuilder subAgents(List&lt;Agent&gt; subAgents) {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException("LoopAgent must have only one subAgent, please use subAgent() method.");
        }

        public LoopAgentBuilder loopStrategy(LoopStrategy loopStrategy) {
            this.loopStrategy = loopStrategy;
            return self();
</code></pre>
<p><strong>循环策略</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>CountLoopStrategy</strong>：固定次数循环</li>
<li><strong>ConditionLoopStrategy</strong>：条件循环（条件为 true 时终止）</li>
<li><strong>ArrayLoopStrategy</strong>：遍历数组元素</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="llmroutingagent---llm-路由-agent">LlmRoutingAgent - LLM 路由 Agent</h3>
<p><code>LlmRoutingAgent</code> 使用 LLM 根据输入内容路由到不同的子 Agent。</p>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-26:84:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/flow/agent/LlmRoutingAgent.java">public class LlmRoutingAgent extends FlowAgent {

	private final ChatModel chatModel;

	protected LlmRoutingAgent(LlmRoutingAgentBuilder builder) throws GraphStateException {
		super(builder.name, builder.description, builder.compileConfig, builder.subAgents);
		this.chatModel = builder.chatModel;
	}

	public static LlmRoutingAgentBuilder builder() {
		return new LlmRoutingAgentBuilder();
	}

	@Override
	protected StateGraph buildSpecificGraph(FlowGraphBuilder.FlowGraphConfig config) throws GraphStateException {
		config.setChatModel(this.chatModel);
		return FlowGraphBuilder.buildGraph(FlowAgentEnum.ROUTING.getType(), config);
	}

	/**
	 * Builder for creating LlmRoutingAgent instances. Extends the common FlowAgentBuilder
	 * and adds LLM-specific configuration.
	 */
	public static class LlmRoutingAgentBuilder extends FlowAgentBuilder&lt;LlmRoutingAgent, LlmRoutingAgentBuilder&gt; {

		private ChatModel chatModel;

		/**
		 * Sets the ChatModel for LLM-based routing decisions.
		 * @param chatModel the chat model to use for routing
		 * @return this builder instance for method chaining
		 */
		public LlmRoutingAgentBuilder model(ChatModel chatModel) {
			this.chatModel = chatModel;
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		protected LlmRoutingAgentBuilder self() {
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		protected void validate() {
			super.validate();
			if (chatModel == null) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("ChatModel must be provided for LLM routing agent");
			}
		}

		@Override
		public LlmRoutingAgent build() throws GraphStateException {
			validate();
			return new LlmRoutingAgent(this);
		}

	}

}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>路由机制</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>使用 LLM 分析输入内容</li>
<li>根据分析结果选择目标 Agent</li>
<li>支持动态路由决策</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="节点能力">节点能力</h2>
<h3 id="conditionevaluator---条件评估器">ConditionEvaluator - 条件评估器</h3>
<p><code>ConditionEvaluator</code> 用于评估条件，支持条件路由。</p>
<p><strong>功能</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>评估状态中的条件表达式</li>
<li>返回布尔值用于路由决策</li>
<li>支持复杂条件逻辑</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="routingedgeaction---路由边动作">RoutingEdgeAction - 路由边动作</h3>
<p><code>RoutingEdgeAction</code> 用于实现路由逻辑，根据条件选择目标节点。</p>
<p><strong>功能</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>根据状态评估路由条件</li>
<li>返回目标节点 ID</li>
<li>支持 LLM 路由和条件路由</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="transparentnode---透明节点">TransparentNode - 透明节点</h3>
<p><code>TransparentNode</code> 是一个透明节点，直接传递状态，不进行任何处理。</p>
<p><strong>功能</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>用于图结构的占位</li>
<li>保持状态不变</li>
<li>简化图结构</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="关键类关系">关键类关系</h2>
<p>以下 PlantUML 类图展示了 Flow Agent 的类关系：</p>

<h2 id="关键流程">关键流程</h2>
<p>以下 PlantUML 时序图展示了 SequentialAgent 的执行流程：<br>

<h2 id="实现关键点说明">实现关键点说明</h2>
<h3 id="1-策略模式">1. 策略模式</h3>
<p>Flow Agent 使用策略模式构建图：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>FlowGraphBuildingStrategy</code> 定义图构建策略接口</li>
<li>每种 Flow Agent 对应一个具体的策略实现</li>
<li><code>FlowGraphBuilder</code> 根据类型选择策略</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2-builder-模式">2. Builder 模式</h3>
<p>所有 Flow Agent 都使用 Builder 模式：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>FlowAgentBuilder</code> 提供通用构建能力</li>
<li>每个具体 Agent 有自己的 Builder 类</li>
<li>支持链式调用和参数验证</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="3-节点转换">3. 节点转换</h3>
<p>子 Agent 通过 <code>asNode()</code> 方法转换为 Graph 节点：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>BaseAgent.asNode()</code> 将 Agent 转换为 <code>SubGraphNode</code></li>
<li>支持 Agent 嵌套和组合</li>
<li>保持状态传递和隔离</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="4-条件路由">4. 条件路由</h3>
<p>支持条件路由能力：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>ConditionEvaluator</code> 评估条件表达式</li>
<li><code>RoutingEdgeAction</code> 实现路由逻辑</li>
<li>支持复杂条件判断</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="5-并行执行">5. 并行执行</h3>
<p>ParallelAgent 实现真正的并行执行：</p>
<ul>
<li>使用 Graph 的并行节点能力</li>
<li>支持最大并发数限制</li>
<li>提供结果合并策略</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="6-循环策略">6. 循环策略</h3>
<p>LoopAgent 支持多种循环策略：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>CountLoopStrategy</code>：固定次数</li>
<li><code>ConditionLoopStrategy</code>：条件循环</li>
<li><code>ArrayLoopStrategy</code>：数组遍历</li>
<li>可扩展自定义策略</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="总结说明">总结说明</h2>
<h3 id="核心设计理念">核心设计理念</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>编排模式</strong>：提供顺序、并行、循环、路由四种编排模式</li>
<li><strong>策略模式</strong>：通过策略模式实现灵活的图构建</li>
<li><strong>节点能力</strong>：支持条件评估、路由选择等节点能力</li>
<li><strong>可组合性</strong>：支持 Agent 嵌套和组合</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="关键优势">关键优势</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>灵活性</strong>：支持多种编排模式，满足不同场景需求</li>
<li><strong>可扩展性</strong>：通过策略模式支持自定义编排逻辑</li>
<li><strong>性能</strong>：并行执行提高处理效率</li>
<li><strong>智能路由</strong>：LLM 路由实现智能 Agent 选择</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="使用场景">使用场景</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>SequentialAgent</strong>：需要顺序处理的多步骤任务</li>
<li><strong>ParallelAgent</strong>：可以并行处理的独立任务</li>
<li><strong>LoopAgent</strong>：需要循环处理的任务（如批量处理）</li>
<li><strong>LlmRoutingAgent</strong>：需要根据内容智能选择处理方式的场景</li>
</ul>
<p>Flow Agent 系列为多 Agent 编排提供了完整的解决方案，使开发者能够灵活构建复杂的 Agent 工作流。</p>
